```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

Class Exercise 1.

```{r}
fitness_df <- read_csv(here("data/higham_fitness_notclean.csv"))
fitness_df

weekend_vec <- c("Sat", "Sun")
weekend_vec
weekday_vec <- c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri")

fitness_df |> mutate(weekend_ind = if_else(weekday %in% weekday_vec,
                                           true = "a weekday",
                                           false = "a weekend")) |>
  relocate(weekend_ind)
## weekday %in% weekday_vec is equivalent to weekday == "Mon" | weekday == "Tue"......

```

Class Exercise 2.

```{r}
set.seed(15125141)
toy_df <- tibble(xvar = rnorm(100, 3, 4),
                 yvar = rnorm(100, -5, 10),
                 group1 = sample(c("A", "B", "C"), size = 100, replace = TRUE),
                 group2 = sample(c("Place1", "Place2", "Place3"), size = 100,
                                 replace = TRUE))
toy_df

table(toy_df$group1)

toy_df |> group_by(group1) |> summarise(count = n()) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group1", values_from = "count")
  
table(toy_df$group1, toy_df$group2)

toy_df |> group_by(group1, group2) |> summarise(count = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group2", values_from = "count")
```

Class Exercise 3.


```{r}
grades_df <- structure(list(section = c(1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 
1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 
1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1030, 1140, 1140, 1140, 
1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 
1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140, 1140
), grade = c("3.5", "3.5", "3.75", "2.5", "3.75", "3.75", "3", 
"3.5", "4", "3.75", "3", "3.75", "3", "3", "3.25", "2.5", "3.25", 
"3.5", "2.25", "4", "2.5", "3.75", "0", "4", "3.75", "3.25", 
"4", "3.75", "2.75", "2.5", "3.75", "3.75", "3.5", "4", "3.25", 
"3.75", "3.5", "1.75", "4", "3", "2.75", "0", "3.75", "3.5", 
"3.75", "1.75", "3.5", "3.25", "3.25", "4")), class = c("tbl_df", 
"tbl", "data.frame"), row.names = c(NA, -50L))

grades_df
```

a and b.

```{r}
grades_df |> 
  mutate(grade = as.numeric(grade)) |> ## grade must be numeric
  group_by(section) |>
  summarise(mean_grade = mean(grade))
```

c and d.

```{r}
grades_df <- grades_df |> mutate(grade = as.numeric(grade),
                                 section = as.factor(section))
## grade must be numeric, section must be character or factor.
ggplot(data = grades_df, aes(x = section, y = grade)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 8)
```
